svg.title: Matched training-seed curriculum comparison
svg.desc: Every point is one training seed. Black bars show means. The lower panel shows paired differences and 95% training-seed bootstrap intervals; the dashed line marks the five-percentage-point target.

g.text: 375 matched training seeds per curriculum · validation tasks
Ambiguous-only minus baseline: paired difference (percentage points)
Dots may overlap; individual values are in the analysis JSON.
